text:
Type: geometric jacquard throw cushion
Use: accent seating comfort, on a sofa or a bed; living room, bedroom
Style: rustic, bohemian, farmhouse
Materials: woven jacquard fabric
Colors: cream, warm rust, mustard ochre, olive grey
Shape: square, horizontal bands of diamonds, crosses, hearts and zigzags, flat woven texture, knife edges, large
Feel: warm, earthy, lively
Goes with: leather, natural wood, cream and rust tones; rustic, bohemian or southwestern rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Rustic Geometric Throw Pillow - 20 x 20 Inch, Earth Tones
product.description: Made in USA and imported Patterned woven stripe brings a unique, southwester flair to your space in soft, earthy tones. Back of pillow is solid taupe-colored fabric. Hidden zipper at bottom of pillow. 20"L x 20"W Pillow cover and insert Spot clean. Pillow insert arrives in vacuum-sealed bag. Carefully remove insert from packaging. and let it fully expand before putting inside of pillow cover.
